notes: Pauses hidden web timers to reduce background work while Reels is in front, without promising stutter-free Instagram. Adds optional direct reel-link sharing from the real Instagram Android share sheet. Enable once in unlocked Settings > Quick reel sharing, off by default per device. Then valid reel links send to linked Chat without diary UI, PIN or send confirmation. Anyone with the unlocked device or another app offering a valid reel link can use it. Permission expires after 90 days; sign-out/account change/Friend mode clears local permission; Disable revokes all your devices. Internet required; uncertain delivery means check Chat before sharing again. No offline retry. Chat copy-paste shortcut removed. Reel links open exact reels inside Dear Diary using that device Instagram session; both devices need 2.12 for in-app opening. No video download or inline player. Actual Instagram menu, Keystore, phone performance and tablet behavior not tested on device. Install over existing APK, do not uninstall.
